qualification_method: Final broad Store and native-provider suites run in separate phases, retaining two test threads per suite. Focused Store tests and actual AI-caller/profile runs are counted only once through their full suites. Three ignored Store subprocess entrypoints are intentionally invoked by their parent tests.
behavior: Schema62 fixes each public provider reservation to one context owner/stable logical operation ID, original context credential, exact native Connection/generation/runtime, verified Vapi Endpoint, complete listener epochs and historical selection. Replay preserves the reservation and cannot redirect it with another credential or source incarnation.

Preparation consumes the original reader, releases its interval before metadata writers, and resolves current authority again. Creation/export acquire independent current complete intervals. Service checks actual native liveness and activation without nested Store permission acquisition during IO.

Creation and export each reserve one attempt before possible IO. The original selected body is revalidated at its saved watermark, so newer history cannot replace it. Raw context in the provider reader requires a captured reference; the export capability accepts only the exact echoed body. Generic receipt completion cannot manufacture delivery.

Public and private creation observers now share a transaction-bound freshness check across captured context deliveries, provider jobs, voice calls, private provider contexts and native public contexts. A failing-before regression admitted older pair-only model memory despite a safe new public selection. The fixed regression refuses the reference before export or cleanup, and a real HTTP duplicate-reference profile records uncertainty without a WebSocket export or end command to that foreign reference.

Exact acknowledgment records delivered; definite rejection and observed truncation record failure. Missing acknowledgment or an unusable creation response remains uncertain. Actual provider termination before acknowledgment records uncertain/incomplete context and captured closure without another end command. Captured observations remain recordable after context credential revocation but cannot authorize further data IO.

Cleanup reserves one end attempt for the captured call. Successful terminal status/exchange records closure; lost transport keeps cleanup uncertain. Native source liveness and original opaque-memory source permissions are revalidated while the owned context session is active. Provider cleanup retains the original native source.

Journal observations carry original listener epochs, delivery source ID, state/problem, captured reference and provider lifecycle flags. Recovery batches at most1000 rows, retains possible effects as uncertain, distinguishes definitely unstarted work, fences foreign runtimes, and never resumes external IO or adopts an old capability. Snapshot digests cover the new table.

The real signed-native AI-caller fixture exercises nine public provider profiles on generation1, exact attributed public context, private-source exclusion, one HTTP creation and no repeated creation/export on logical replay. It then completes the existing private-only purpose with actual duplex audio and return. This does not qualify public provider-native audio forwarding.

Existing discovery, artifact, membership, provider-chat, escaped >128KB canonical HTTP/real SDK initialization, private consultation lifecycle and failure/recovery behavior pass in their recorded profiles. Store owns authorization and durable records, Service owns actual native checks, and Server owns provider IO. No upstream source edit, compatibility restoration or publication occurred.
